in_marathi.name: Khushali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy and Happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khushali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Khushali is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Khush’, which means happiness and joy. The name signifies a state of inner peace, contentment, and satisfaction. It is believed that a person named Khushali is blessed with a joyful and blissful life.
